sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording; refer Policy Schedule

room_rent.note: Room rent limit not stated in wording; specified in Policy Schedule per plan

icu.note: ICU limit not stated in wording; specified in Policy Schedule per plan

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in wording for Silver plan

sub_limits.note: Modern treatments sub-limited to 50% of SI; domiciliary capped at 10% of SI; day care listed procedures only

deductible.note: No deductible stated for Silver plan

ped_waiting.note: Wording states 24/48 months as specified in Policy Schedule; best (lowest) is 24 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: Cataract, hernia, BPH, hysterectomy, dialysis, gastric ulcers etc.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% renewal discount per claim-free year, max 20%; forfeited on claim

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in wording

pre_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Policy Schedule

post_hosp.note: Number of days specified in Policy Schedule

day_care.note: Only procedures listed in Annexure D are covered

domiciliary.note: Requires 3+ continuous days; several conditions excluded

organ_donor.note: Donor in-patient hospitalisation expenses covered; pre/post-hosp for donor excluded

ambulance.display: Up to limit in Policy Schedule
ambulance.note: Reasonable and customary charges up to limit specified in Policy Schedule

consumables.note: Medicines, drugs and consumables covered under in-patient benefit; non-medical consumables per Annexure A excluded

notable_exclusions: Overseas treatment, STDs, sleep apnea, external congenital anomaly, hearing aids/spectacles, RMO/service charges, circumcision, self-injury
optional_riders: Daily hospitalisation allowance; nursing allowance; recovery benefit; accompanying person expenses
